absent: Buddy allocator free list management, order calculations and isolation helpers beyond the reporting call sites.
Slab allocation, page extension allocation and reclaim paths beyond verification exclusions.
Definitions and contracts of stack iteration start and next, threshold file operations and main owner file operations.
Full layouts of stack, stack record, print context, zone, free area, device info, scatterlist, page, folio, vma and page extension structures.
Numeric values of poison pattern, pageblock order, maximum order, reporting capacity limit and watermark helpers.
Callers, lock context and error handling for poison, unpoison, mapping hooks and mapped address lookup.
Rate limit parameters persistence and log output routing beyond the bounded diagnostics shown.
Debugfs mount, permission enforcement and lifetime beyond file creation shown.

findings.text: Memory debugging exposes operations to poison and validate runs of consecutive base pages plus a mapping hook that intentionally performs no work because poisoning carries the protection.

Free page reporting exposes registration and unregistration for a single device instance. Registration publishes the device and enables notifications while unregistration clears publication and synchronously cancels pending work.

Page table verification exposes hooks invoked on clearing and installing entries at several table levels, on zeroing ranges and on tearing down tables, plus a query that resolves whether a given page appears mapped inside a given address range.

Stack usage display derives base page count from a shared reference count minus one, suppresses entries with no record and suppresses low counts below one or below a tunable threshold when page counts are requested, and conditionally emits symbolic addresses, handle identifiers and counts according to view flags before a separating blank line.

Freed pages are filled with a uniform poison pattern while temporarily mapped with current sanitizer tracking suspended, and allocated pages are scanned over their full extent for pattern deviations before reuse, so any prior content or stray write is detected on the next allocation path.

Reporting scans free lists from a tunable minimum order upward across migratetypes except isolate, skips pages already flagged as reported, requires a low watermark plus capacity scaled by order to guarantee progress, and only flags a drained page as reported when it remains an uncoalesced buddy of the same order.

Each page extension maintains separate anonymous and file mapping counts that are mutually exclusive, incremented on installation and decremented on removal, with writable anonymous mappings constrained against multiple sharers and with kernel address space and huge zero pages excluded from accounting.

Mapping lookup resolves the folio and intra folio offset for a single page, derives the expected address through anonymous versus file backed helpers, performs a synchronous walk in the supplied area, and reports a fault sentinel when the address is invalid or the walk misses.

Free list inspection and isolation hold the zone spinlock with interrupts disabled, release it across the device report callback to avoid sleeping under spinlock, then reacquire it to drain results, with list rotation used to preserve progress across the unlock window.

Device registration lifetime is serialized by a dedicated mutex with RCU publication for readers, while page extension counter walks are enclosed in RCU read side critical sections and threshold access uses single copy atomic accessors.

Stack views are presented through sequence iteration using display and lifecycle callbacks together with file handling for open release read and seek, with per open private context carrying view flags taken from inode private data.

Verification state per page extension consists of two atomic counters for anonymous and file mappings, described by page extension operations giving the state size together with need and initialization callbacks and indicating no shared flag requirement.

Reporting configuration combines an order value with setter logic bounded by zero and maximum order and a signed getter preserving a negative unspecified sentinel, a millisecond delay default, a read mostly RCU device pointer, and a three valued lifecycle of idle requested and active.

Reporting work starts idle, moves to active on worker entry, returns to idle on completion when no further request arrived, remains requested when budget exhaustion or concurrent request demands continuation, and reschedules itself after a delay in that case.

Poisoned pages transition from fully patterned while free to validated on allocation, where a fully patterned buffer stays silent and any deviation triggers bounded diagnostic output before the page is handed out.

Initialization checks an enablement branch and when enabled installs a main owner file, a stacks directory with three filtered views combining symbolic stacks page counts and handles, and a writable threshold control backed by dedicated get and set handlers.

Early boot options parse booleans for page poisoning and table verification, a module style parameter controls reporting order within bounds, registration triggers an initial asynchronous zone sweep, and a delayed worker iterates all zones draining partial batches at the end.

Corruption detection bounds output with a rate limiter, separates a one bit deviation from wider memory corruption in diagnostics, and emits address prefixed hex context plus stack and page details, risking log volume and blocking work if corruption is persistent.

Verification treats slab pages, missing extensions, cross type counts, counter underflow, multiple writable anonymous sharers and file counter wrap as fatal inconsistencies, and treats present writable userfault entries and cached writable swap entries as one time warnings.

Stable interface facts include header include guards, debugfs permission bits for read only and read write entries, a two second reporting delay default, idle requested active numeric progression from zero, an unspecified order sentinel distinct from valid orders, and a log prefix for verification messages.
Debugfs entry names comprise count_threshold and show_stacks_handles alongside show_handles and show_stacks under page_owner_stacks with a top level page_owner file.
